SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(created_on, '%b-%y') AS Month,
  SUM(kwh) AS FinalKilowattHours
FROM
  hul.energy_usage
WHERE
  meter_name IN (
    '2F4-63A|BL-3,SHRINKTUNNALM/C',
    '3F5-32A|POSIMATMCBL',
    '3F6-32A|AUTOPACK',
    '4F2-32A|BOTTLINGLINECONVEYOR',
    '4F4-32A|BOTTLINGLINE03CONVEYOR',
    '2F3-63A|VOLPACK',
    '2F7-32|VOLPACKCLDFORMMINGMACHINE',
    '2F2-32A|MIXER08VACUMELIFTER',
    '2F2-63A|VIMVOLPACKCASHPACKER',
    '2F3-32A|VIMVOLPACKCASHPACKERCONVEYOR',
    '3F2-63A|TJBYPASSCONVEYOR',
    '3F5-100A|LOOP6&7FLXLINKCONVEYORPANEL',
    '4F3-32A|BLCLDMAKINGM/C',
    '5F1-12A|MIXER-08HOMONIGERPUMP',
    '5F4-50A|YSTRALMIXER08',
    '4R2-32A|BLPOSIMATALPINECONVEYOR',
    '4R3-32A|BOTTELLINE3LEBLINGMACHINE',
    '160A MIXER-08 VFD PANEL',
    '4F3-32A|VOLPACKCHILLER'
  )
  AND created_on >= DATE_SUB(
    DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'),
    INTERVAL 6 MONTH
  )
  AND created_on <= LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY
  DATE_FORMAT(created_on, '%b-%y'),
  DATE_FORMAT(created_on, '%Y-%m-01')
ORDER BY
  DATE_FORMAT(created_on, '%Y-%m-01');

SELECT
  rd AS time,
  SUM(kwh) / 1000 AS FinalKilowattHoursPerCLS1
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      meter_name,
      DATE(reading_day) as rd,
      reading_date,
      MAX(kwh) as kwh
    FROM
      hul.hul_shift_emreadings
    WHERE
      $__timeFilter(reading_day)
      AND DATE(reading_day) < CURDATE()
      AND meter_name IN (
        '2F4-63A|BL-3,SHRINKTUNNALM/C',
        '3F5-32A|POSIMATMCBL',
        '3F6-32A|AUTOPACK',
        '4F2-32A|BOTTLINGLINECONVEYOR',
        '4F4-32A|BOTTLINGLINE03CONVEYOR',
        '2F3-63A|VOLPACK',
        '2F7-32|VOLPACKCLDFORMMINGMACHINE',
        '2F2-32A|MIXER08VACUMELIFTER',
        '2F2-63A|VIMVOLPACKCASHPACKER',
        '2F3-32A|VIMVOLPACKCASHPACKERCONVEYOR',
        '3F2-63A|TJBYPASSCONVEYOR',
        '3F5-100A|LOOP6&7FLXLINKCONVEYORPANEL',
        '4F3-32A|BLCLDMAKINGM/C',
        '5F1-12A|MIXER-08HOMONIGERPUMP',
        '5F4-50A|YSTRALMIXER08',
        '4R2-32A|BLPOSIMATALPINECONVEYOR',
        '4R3-32A|BOTTELLINE3LEBLINGMACHINE',
        '160A MIXER-08 VFD PANEL',
        '4F3-32A|VOLPACKCHILLER'
      )
    GROUP BY
      meter_name,
      DATE(reading_day),
      reading_date
  ) t
GROUP BY
  rd
ORDER BY
  rd;

SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(rd, '%d-%m-%Y') AS Date,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN shift = 'A' THEN kwh
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS `Shift-A`,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN shift = 'B' THEN kwh
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS `Shift-B`,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN shift = 'C' THEN kwh
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS `Shift-C`
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      meter_name,
      shift,
      DATE(reading_day) AS rd,
      reading_date,
      MAX(kwh) AS kwh
    FROM
      hul.hul_shift_emreadings
    WHERE
